observation.visible_scene: A low, close-angle view of a dark non-stick frying pan on a stovetop, filled with cooked shrimp topped with chopped green herbs and scattered pale garlic bits; translucent steam rises above the food, and a blurred background of green herbs and a pinkish object is visible behind the pan rim.
visible_changes: Steam wisps continuously rise, swirl and re-form from frame to frame, the most active motion in the clip.
The shrimp, herbs and garlic pieces hold fixed positions throughout; there is no stirring, flipping or sliding of the food within the pan.
Small bright flecks appear near the top edge of the frame in scattered moments (e.g. around t=0.4–0.6, 0.8–0.9, 1.9–2.4 s) and drift downward from above the visible area.

The framing drifts slightly: a small metal tab on the pan's left rim, absent in the first frames, becomes visible at the left edge in later frames, indicating a minor camera or pan repositioning rather than food movement.
The scattered garlic crumbs on the left interior of the pan remain in place, confirming the pan itself is largely stationary relative to the food.
outside_clip_unknowns: What or who releases the falling flecks seen at the top edge, since the source is above the frame.
Any earlier or later action on the shrimp (seasoning, tossing, serving) beyond this excerpt.
The exact contents of the blurred background.
uncertain_details: Whether the left-rim tab's appearance is due to a small camera pan/zoom or a slight rotation of the pan.
The identity of the falling flecks (herb, garlic or other debris).
Whether the background shift is camera motion or independent movement, given the shallow depth of field.
